api: verify_acceptance_bundle(repo, bundle, independent_review) returns True only after all observations validate; raises existing AssuranceError otherwise.
cli: bundle --repo ROOT --bundle FILE --review FILE; strict JSON; exit0 only after validation, otherwise diagnostic/nonzero with no PASS. Reuse existing read-only CLI and strict parsing helpers.

shape.feature_id: Nonempty string; this contract tests116; no external scope/auth claim.
shape.baseline: Closed object commit/tree full40lowerhex. Actual commit/tree Git objects must match; no ambientHEAD substitution. This baseline freezes independent tests and source obligations before implementation, not the later product candidate.
shape.inputs: Nonempty sorted list of closed {kind,path,sha256,executable} records. Kinds test,obligation,interface,baseline_control must all occur. baseline_control is the independently authored, deliberately naive but importable/callable policy fixture used by every baseline control/red, frozen as actual baseline Git bytes; it is not developer product implementation. Portable relative unique regular files with no symlink components; lowercaseSHA256 and exactbool executable. Actual immutable baseline Git blob/mode and current bytes must both match. Obligation input is a separately frozen snapshot of approved116 obligations (scope/verification/API/budgets/non-goals) in E116, NOT mutable canonical contract/lifecycle/QA bytes. Snapshot reviewer checks against actual approved contract.
shape.environment: Exact observed115-compatible {runtime:{implementation,version,system,machine},variables:{NAME:VALUE}} object, string values. Verify runtime via platform and variables via actual os.environ; missing/drift invalidates. No caller-provided digest authority.
shape.roles: Closed object test_author/developer/acceptance_reviewer. Each exact {agent_id,session_id}, nonempty strings; every agent_id and every session_id must be pairwise distinct. These are local recorded identities, not cryptographic authentication.
shape.required_cases: Nonempty unique nonempty strings in canonical sorted order; independent pre-code/bundle reviewer confirms completeness against frozen obligations.
shape.baseline_evidence: Exactly one row per required_case, no duplicate/unknown/missing cases. Exact row keys case,operation,setup,positive,red. operation has exact target,positive_input,case_input,mutation,expected_result fields: target=verify_acceptance_bundle; each input is a closed {path,sha256} reference to actual strict JSON operation/input fixture bytes; paths safe/regular and hashes observed. positive_input and case_input must differ by path and digest. mutation is a nonempty case-specific explanation, expected_result is accept or reject. For four reject cases expected_result=reject; independent-handoff=accept with an actual independent handoff/record-only candidate transition. Proofs setup/positive/red each have exact path,sha256,command,revision,diagnostic fields with actual safe regular file bytes/hash; command/diagnostic nonempty; revision=baseline.commit. All proof/input paths are distinct within and across case rows. Proof/input outputs are sealed by captured hashes, outside their own hash and not required to preexist in the assessed baseline Git tree.
shape.seal_sha256: Exact lowercase SHA256 of existing canonical(bundle without seal_sha256). Computed seal binds EVERY input, role, case and evidence field. Separate reviewer record binds same seal; changing bundle/bytes/environment requires genuinely new reviewed bundle/red evidence before implementation resumes.

proof_rules: Each external proof has exactly one COMMAND, REVISION and EXIT header matching its case row. Setup EXIT0 and diagnostic in actual STDOUT. Setup must import the existing115 API, exercise actual callable harness/CLI and import the frozen deliberately naive baseline_control target; its output includes exact TARGET_CALLABLE: verify_acceptance_bundle PASS. Missing116 product API may establish availability only; a missing API/callable, AttributeError or renamed missing-policy assertion NEVER qualifies as intended red for ANY listed case.

Every case MUST have a personally replayed positive control executing the importable/callable naive policy with positive_input and producing EXIT0 plus exact POSITIVE_CONTROL: CASE PASS in STDOUT. Positive proof INPUT_SHA256 equals positive_input actualhash; OPERATION_SHA256 equals canonical operation hash. This proves successful runnable target behavior rather than general115 setup alone.

Every case MUST have its own operation/input and intended behavioral red executing the SAME frozen callable naive policy on case_input after successful setup/positive control. Red proof INPUT_SHA256 equals case_input actualhash; OPERATION_SHA256 equals canonical operation hash; EXIT1 and exact POLICY_ASSERTION diagnostic containing case name must occur in actual STDOUT/STDERR. The naive policy must produce the wrong ACCEPT/REJECT outcome for that specific operation, not merely lack116API. Each red output also contains exact OBSERVED_RESULT: accept or reject opposite operation.expected_result. Missing proof/control, unchanged input digest, wrong operation/result, positive redexit, transport/shell127/import/missingcallable/genericunrelatedexception fail closed.

Four rejection cases mutate their own invariant from valid input: shared role identity; seal/input/env drift; absent intended-red record; setup/transport evidence substituted as red. independent-handoff exercises a valid distinct-role approved-seal handoff with actual later record-only candidate transition that a naive ambientHEAD-bound control wrongly rejects; its positive control verifies the valid starting input before transition. Both controls/reds are independent fixture behavior, not future developer Source.

Independent bundle reviewer personally replays ALL five case-specific valid positives and intended behavioral reds against frozen baseline_control/test bytes and checks actual operation/input/result bindings. Review cannot approve five differently renamed absence assertions or a shared setup error. Developer Source/test/guard remain unwritten/unmodified until renewed dualprecode and actual bundle approval.
review_rules: Exact closed JSON object. review=validator-test-bundle-review, feature=bundle.feature_id; actor/session equal recorded acceptance_reviewer. final_verdict exact {approved:true,summary:nonemptystring}; all three blocker arrays exactly[]. seal_sha256 equals recomputed seal. Independent review output is separate and never part of sealed inputs, its own hash or earlier red proof. Producer explicitly emits this exact nine-field record at .agent/validator/116-test-bundle-review.json; richer ownership/replay evidence is separately externalized under E116, never extra API fields.
candidate_boundary: Do NOT call115 assess_repository on current implementation against pre-code baseline. Current SourceC identity is separately frozen from actual Git commit/tree plus product/test/API/independent scope guard current hashes and shared by actual ModeB/freshQA/capture. Mutable canonical contract/coordination outputs remain outside bundle inputs. Immutable baseline/source obligations remain unchanged across truthful later completion.
runner: Independent Evaluator adds five named cases and --base-cases (runs EXACT existing11), --scope-116 --base COMMIT and --scope-controls-116 --base COMMIT. Default runs currently available16cases. Existing115 --scope interfaces retain historical implementation but are NOT rerun as current116 proof. Unknown/future case/check/flag fails nonzero. No permanent fixtures directories.
ownership: Independent author owns actual test/scope bytes; separate reviewer binds/freeze-reviews those bytes and personally observes valid setup/intended reds before developer source. Source developer may not edit sealed tests/guard/API/snapshots/evidence. Changed bundle requires renewed distinct review. Only Root owns lifecycle/counters/budget/phase/list/manifest/current projections.
